seasonalNotes: Mild wet climate year-round. Rain likely any day — always carry an umbrella. Short daylight in winter (4 PM sunset Dec). Summer evenings long (9 PM sunset Jun).

personas.name: London Work Day
personas.tagline: Tube, meetings, and a Tesco run
personas.description: Commutes from Clapham to the City via Northern line. Office meetings, Pret lunch, post-work Tesco shop, and Overground home.

stops.title: Grab umbrella + Oyster card
stops.description: Rain is likely; please carry an umbrella.
stops.action: Check the weather app and pack an umbrella. Make sure your Oyster card is topped up.
stops.context: London weather is unpredictable—rain is always possible.
stops.wellbeing: Dress in layers and wear comfortable shoes.
stops.motivation: Preparedness means less stress on your commute!
stops.localization: Contactless cards work on all TfL services.
stops.transition: Walk to Clapham Common Tube Station.
stops.feedback: Did this tip help you start your day smoothly?

stops.title: Top up Oyster if under £5
stops.description: Check balance at the gate. Top up at machine.
stops.action: Check your Oyster balance at the gate. Top up at the machine if needed.
stops.context: Morning rush hour can mean queues at the machines.
stops.wellbeing: Keep your bag zipped and valuables secure.
stops.motivation: A topped-up card means no delays!
stops.localization: All major cards accepted at top-up machines.
stops.transition: Board the Northern line towards Bank.
stops.feedback: Did this reminder help you avoid travel hiccups?

stops.title: 10 AM client call — prep notes
stops.description: Review deck in the lift. Conference room B.
stops.action: Review your meeting notes and join the call on time.
stops.context: Conference rooms can be busy—arrive a few minutes early.
stops.wellbeing: Take a few deep breaths before the meeting.
stops.transition: After the call, check your to-do list for the afternoon.
stops.feedback: Did this call reminder help you stay on track?

stops.title: Post parcel at Royal Mail
stops.description: Return the Amazon parcel. Label printed.
stops.action: Bring your parcel and printed label. Use the self-service kiosk if available.
stops.context: Lunch hour is busy—expect a short wait.
stops.wellbeing: Wash your hands after handling parcels.
stops.motivation: Ticking off errands frees up your evening!
stops.localization: Royal Mail accepts prepaid returns at all branches.
stops.transition: Return to the office or grab lunch nearby.
stops.feedback: Did this errand reminder help you?

stops.title: Tesco shop — milk, bread, pasta
stops.action: Check your shopping list and scan your Clubcard for discounts.
stops.context: Evenings are busy—shop quickly to avoid crowds.
stops.wellbeing: Carry reusable bags to reduce plastic waste.
stops.motivation: Smart shopping saves money and time!
stops.localization: Tesco Express stores are open late.
stops.feedback: Did this shopping tip help you today?

personas.name: Manchester Uni Day
personas.tagline: Lectures, library, and a chippy tea
personas.description: A University of Manchester student: morning lectures, library grind, Arndale Centre errands, and chippy tea near Piccadilly.

stops.title: Bus pass + laptop charger
stops.description: 142 bus. Check you've got your student ID too.

stops.title: Return overdue library books
stops.description: 3 books, 2 weeks late. Fines stacking up.

stops.title: Phone case from Arndale
stops.description: Cracked screen protector. Get one from the kiosk.

stops.title: Chippy tea near Piccadilly
stops.description: Fish, chips, mushy peas. Eat-in or takeaway.

personas.name: London Tourist Day
personas.tagline: Big Ben, Borough Market, and the Tate
personas.description: Classic London sightseeing: Westminster, Borough Market lunch, Tate Modern, South Bank walk, and evening in Covent Garden.

stops.title: Big Ben + Parliament photos
stops.description: Best angle from Westminster Bridge. Go before 9 AM.

stops.title: Borough Market — get the toastie
stops.description: Kappacasein raclette. Queue will be long but worth it.

stops.title: Tate Modern — Turbine Hall
stops.description: Free entry. Check what's in the Turbine Hall this month.

stops.title: South Bank walk to Westminster
stops.description: Book stalls, street performers, river views.

stops.title: Covent Garden — dinner
stops.description: Book a table or grab street food in the piazza.
